args.subject: PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark
args.body:
June,

From Sofia Marchetti (Coastal team), a note on a label mix-up:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals'.
- The saved report's label looks out of date and may need updating to the Pellow Home Living name.

Sent from the workspace assistant on Sofia's behalf. Sofia can add detail if needed.

args.text:

Sofia, I saved a draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the PHL label note, and posted the same bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message. The draft is unsent, so you or someone else needs to send it.

Finish Sofia's note and save it as a mail draft to June Osei-Lark with the subject 'PHL label cleanup': add that the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
